{{Top}}
The '''Rubicon navicomputer''' was a model of [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] manufactured by [[Microaxial/Legends|Microaxial]]. It was installed at the factory on [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had one that [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] upgraded with extra memory modules.
